arguments:
set -Eeuo pipefail
export GIT_PAGER=cat PAGER=cat GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT=0 PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1
tmp="$(mktemp -d /tmp/rea-plcodex-cwd-postmerge.XXXXXX)"
trap 'rm -rf "$tmp"' EXIT
git clone --quiet --depth 2 --branch main https://github.com/martaxi-boss/Project-leader-codex.git "$tmp/repo"
cd "$tmp/repo"
test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = 3ecdcd79573104c39ed644dbfd1bd57596e51d06
printf 'FINAL_MAIN_SHA='; git rev-parse HEAD
python3 - <<'PY'
import hashlib
from pathlib import Path
expected={
"codex/dual.py":"56ce220f8a852f1c0d7d03e3bee17b6dd16c7bde944e5df14468e74ef66f4763",
"codex/tests/test_smart.py":"c9f1cda7b115993b3d616d90ecdf1cc38b3b628fb7c4e3823f1d86ad7ea293a1",
}
for p,v in expected.items():
 assert hashlib.sha256(Path(p).read_bytes()).hexdigest()==v,p
 print("POSTMERGE_TESTED_BYTES_MATCH",p,flush=True)
assert "one portable" in Path("AGENTS.md").read_text().lower()

python3 -m unittest codex.tests.test_smart.SmartRunTests.test_codex_cli_child_starts_inside_independent_writable_clone -q
